title: Choose the composition for the finance dashboard
question: The roll assigned the Split Ledger. Keep it, take another dealt structure, or re-roll.

options.label: Split Ledger
options.lineage: double-entry ledger pages; in/out columns meeting at a net
options.thesis: The month is read as a ledger: money in on the left, money out on the right, the net carried on a spine between them.
options.viewport: Header with month stepper; the KPI band splits into IN (income), a deep-teal net spine (balance, savings rate) and OUT (spending); the 6-month chart below paints income as a column with the spent portion solid and the kept portion hatched.
options.risk: The two-sided band can read as decoration if the tint does not carry real state.

options.label: Ledger Rail
options.thesis: A sticky this-month rail owns the headline numbers and the budgets; the working area beside it owns the charts and the transactions.
options.viewport: Left 360px sticky rail: balance, income, spending, savings rate as stacked tiles plus the budget bars. Right column: 6-month chart, category chart, transactions.
options.risk: The rail grows tall; budgets compete with the headline numbers for attention.

options.label: Two-Band Month
options.thesis: A full-width month band carries the stepper, the balance and the savings rate; the work sits in three zones under it.
options.viewport: Deep-teal masthead with the month stepper, balance and savings rate; below it a KPI strip, then the charts, then transactions and budgets.
options.risk: The masthead can swallow the KPI row into a hero-metric clich.
